en.bdb: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਾ: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸ ਓਨਮ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ॥
verses.translit_en: soraThaa: aadh purakh aadhes onam sree satigur charan ||

en.bdb: Sorath: My Supplication to Ad(i) Purakh (Primordial Lord), salutation the holy feet of the True Guru (who is the embodiment of the Lord)

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਕਾ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਸਸਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: ghaT ghaT kaa paraves ek anek bibek sas ||

en.bdb: Like the moon, who though one, resides everywhere and in everyone and yet remains one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੋਹਰਾ: ਓਨਮ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhoharaa: onam sree satigur charan aadh purakh aadhes ||

en.bdb: Dohra: Salutation in the holy feet of Satguru, the embodiment of glorious Waheguru who is the Primeval Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਸਸਿ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਕਾ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥
verses.translit_en: ek anek bibek sas ghaT ghaT kaa paraves ||

en.bdb: He is like the moon, Who though one is present everywhere and yet remains one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛੰਦ: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਕਾ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਸੇਸ ਪਹਿ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: chha(n)dh: ghaT ghaT kaa paraves ses peh kahat na aavai ||

en.bdb: Channt: Waheguru (Lord) who is all-pervading and whose extent cannot be defined even by Sheshnag (a mythological serpent with thousand heads),

verses.gurmukhi: ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਬੰਦੀਜਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: net net keh net bedh ba(n)dheejan gaavai ||

en.bdb: Whose praises Ved, Bhats and aIl others have been singing since eons and yet say-not this, not even this.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅਰੁ ਅੰਤ ਹੁਤੇ ਹੁਤ ਹੈ ਪੁਨ ਹੋਨਮ ॥
verses.translit_en: aadh madh ar a(n)t hute hut hai pun honam ||

en.bdb: Who was there in the beginning, in between era and will remain in future,

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸ ਚਰਨ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਓਨਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit_en: aadh purakh aadhes charan sree satigur onam ||1||

en.bdb: My supplication to Him through the holy feet of the True Guru in which He is totally effulgent. (1)
